name: forward_message
description:
Forward an Outlook email to new recipients. The Outlook server automatically includes
the original message content with forwarding headers.

Optionally include a note above the forwarded content using the comment field
(also accepts additional_message).

message_id.description: Message ID of the email to forward (from outlook_search or outlook_get_message)

comment.description: Optional note to prepend above the forwarded content (also accepts 'additional_message')
